description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 02.02.2015 to 08.02.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification pertains to legal/regulatory matters concerning customs operations. It exercises powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish official exchange rates for customs duties and charges, and formally rescinds a previous notification. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
